description: Add Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) system with JWT authentication, user management, role-based permissions, and document folder assignment. Roles: admin, reviewer, editor, annotator, approver.
steps: Add dependencies via 'uv add': python-jose[cryptography], passlib[bcrypt], pyjwt. Run 'uv sync'.

Create app/models/user.py: Define User model (id, username, email, hashed_password, is_active, created_at, updated_at) and Role model (id, name as enum: admin/reviewer/editor/annotator/approver, description). Define UserRole association table (user_id, role_id). Define FolderAssignment model (id, user_id, folder_path, role_id, granted_at). All models inherit from the existing Base in app/models/group.py. Add relationships: User.roles -> list[Role], User.folder_assignments -> list[FolderAssignment].

Create app/core/security.py: Implement password hashing (passlib bcrypt), JWT token creation/verification (python-jose), get_current_user dependency (extracts user from Authorization header Bearer token), role_required(roles: list[str]) dependency factory that checks user has required role. Add settings to app/core/config.py: SECRET_KEY, ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES (default 30), ALGORITHM (default HS256).

Create app/schemas/user.py: Define UserCreate (username, email, password), UserResponse (id, username, email, is_active, roles, created_at), Token (access_token, token_type), TokenData (username, roles), RoleAssign (user_id, role_name), FolderAssignmentCreate (user_id, folder_path, role_name), FolderAssignmentResponse (id, user_id, folder_path, role_name, granted_at).

Create app/api/auth.py: POST /api/auth/register (create user), POST /api/auth/login (authenticate, return JWT), GET /api/auth/me (get current user info). Registration creates user with no roles by default. Login validates credentials and returns access_token.

Create app/api/users.py: GET /api/users (admin only - list users), GET /api/users/{id} (admin only - get user details), POST /api/users/{id}/roles (admin only - assign role to user), DELETE /api/users/{id}/roles/{role_name} (admin only - remove role), POST /api/users/{id}/folders (admin only - assign folder access), GET /api/users/{id}/folders (get user's folder assignments), DELETE /api/users/{id}/folders/{assignment_id} (admin only - remove folder assignment).

Add permission-checking middleware: Create a require_folder_access(folder_path, min_role) dependency that checks if the user has access to the specified folder path (exact match or parent path). Apply folder access checks to document endpoints in app/api/documents.py - upload requires editor/admin role for the group, download/view requires any assigned role.
Update app/api/router.py to include auth_router and users_router.
Update app/main.py lifespan to create default admin user (admin/admin) if no users exist, and ensure role records are created in DB.

Create tests/test_auth.py: Test registration, login, JWT validation, invalid credentials, expired token. Test role_required dependency blocks unauthorized access. Test folder assignment access control.
Create tests/test_rbac.py: Test admin can assign/remove roles. Test folder assignments grant correct access. Test permission checks on document endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/auth/register creates a user and returns user info
POST /api/auth/login returns a valid JWT token
GET /api/auth/me with valid token returns current user with roles
Admin user can assign roles (admin, reviewer, editor, annotator, approver) to users
Admin user can assign folder paths to users with specific roles
Document endpoints check folder access permissions
Protected endpoints return 401 without token and 403 without required role
Default admin user is created on first startup
All existing 82+ tests still pass (no regressions)
Running 'uv run ruff check app/ tests/' passes
verification: uv run ruff check app/ tests/
findings: bcrypt 5.x is incompatible with passlib; pinned bcrypt==4.0.1 to resolve. All 146 tests pass (131 existing + 15 new). Lint passes cleanly.
